summary: Strengthen Hansard workflows, editorial quality checks and team planning. Explore the five-day course outline and practical outcomes.
lede: Strategic leadership for parliamentary editors focuses on coordinating transcript review, staff workloads and publication decisions while protecting accuracy and impartiality. For Hansard managers, senior editors and editorial team leaders, it covers workflow assessment, near-verbatim editing and transcript checks against recordings. Participants also practise workload planning, staff coaching and quality measures to support consistent, timely publication.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for editorial professionals who coordinate parliamentary transcripts, people and publication deadlines. It suits practitioners with experience in proceedings records who now need to strengthen unit planning, quality controls and team performance.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with transcript editing, proofreading or parliamentary publication workflows is expected. Coding is not required. Bring a laptop with access to Word and Excel. Exercises use learner-created documents and spreadsheets rather than a course-provided software lab or dataset.
